candidates.title: Prepare invoice checks for staff review

demandEvidence.chore: Check invoice details against agreements and orders and prepare discrepancies for staff review.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Hantera fakturor och kontrollera underlag mot avtal och beställningar

ease.reason: The attached n8n template extracts invoice PDF fields and logs them, but does not compare agreements or orders.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a professional office may value a discrepancy draft; this vacancy does not establish AI-service buyers.

feasibility.reason: A fictional two-week mock can extract fields and log drafts; comparison rules and real system access are unsupported.

autonomy.reason: Extraction and logging can repeat, but staff must define matching rules and resolve every discrepancy.

evidence.reason: The notice names invoice checking against agreements and orders; the template supports extraction and logging only.

candidates.reason: Concrete chore scored as a synthetic review queue; repeated invoice matching has been refused before and this snapshot adds no matching-rule implementation evidence.

candidates.title: Draft invoice and order review fields

demandEvidence.chore: Prepare extracted invoice and spare-parts order details in a review table for a staff member.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Du granskar fakturor, hanterar reservdelsbeställningar, tar fram statistik och ansvarar för rapportering och fakturering

ease.reason: The n8n listing documents invoice PDF extraction and sheet logging; it does not cover spare-parts order handling.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: an office may value a review table for routine administration; the vacancy proves no AI-service demand.

feasibility.reason: A synthetic invoice extraction demo is plausible in two weeks; order fields, reporting rules and integrations are unknown.

autonomy.reason: A workflow could log extracted invoice fields; staff must validate them and handle parts orders and reporting.

evidence.reason: The paid notice lists invoice review, parts orders and reporting; the template documents only invoice extraction and logging.

candidates.reason: A bounded extraction and review-table experiment is assessable, but the notice gives no fields or rules and the attached template covers only invoice extraction/logging.

candidates.title: Sort incoming and outgoing mail for review

demandEvidence.chore: Sort fictional incoming and outgoing mail examples into an operator-defined review list.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Hantering av inkommande och utgående post

ease.reason: A fictional mail sorter is possible, but no attached source documents mail parsing or routing mechanics.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a professional office may value a mail review aid; the notice does not establish AI-service demand.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock can classify synthetic examples, but mail formats, categories and routing rules are absent.

autonomy.reason: A draft category can be generated, but staff must define labels and decide every real routing action.

evidence.reason: The paid notice establishes incoming and outgoing mail handling, without formats, frequency or relevant implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: A synthetic sorting mock is concrete enough to score, but there is no relevant attached implementation reference or mail-format evidence.

rejected.title: Prepare invoice checks for staff review
rejected.reason: Concrete chore scored as a synthetic review queue; repeated invoice matching has been refused before and this snapshot adds no matching-rule implementation evidence. Five-criterion mean 4.6 is below the threshold of 6.

rejected.title: Draft invoice and order review fields
rejected.reason: A bounded extraction and review-table experiment is assessable, but the notice gives no fields or rules and the attached template covers only invoice extraction/logging. Five-criterion mean 4.6 is below the threshold of 6.

rejected.title: Sort incoming and outgoing mail for review
rejected.reason: A synthetic sorting mock is concrete enough to score, but there is no relevant attached implementation reference or mail-format evidence. Five-criterion mean 3.8 is below the threshold of 6.

rejected.title: Paid administrator role
rejected.reason: The fresh notice names only an administrator role and supplies no concrete task; no bounded demandEvidence chore can be quoted or scored without inventing duties.

steps.message: Assessed all four selected professional-services notices. Three concrete chores received five criterion ratings; each stayed below the unrounded threshold. The fourth notice gave no concrete task. No post proposed.
